description: This file contains type definitions for a Long class and related types, used for handling 64-bit integers in JavaScript/TypeScript projects. It defines a LongLike union type and a Long class with static methods, properties, and instance methods for manipulating 64-bit integers.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: A class representing 64-bit signed or unsigned integers, with methods for creation, comparison, arithmetic, bitwise operations, and conversions.

methods.name: constructor(low: number, high?: number, unsigned?: boolean); constructor
methods.description: Constructs a new Long instance given low and high 32-bit parts and an unsigned flag.

methods.name: static fromBits
methods.description: Creates a Long from low and high bits.

methods.name: static fromInt
methods.description: Creates a Long from a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: static fromNumber
methods.description: Creates a Long from a finite number.

methods.name: static fromBigInt
methods.description: Creates a Long from a BigInt.

methods.name: static fromString
methods.description: Creates a Long from a string with optional radix.

methods.name: static fromBytes
methods.description: Creates a Long from a byte array.

methods.name: static isLong
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Long.

methods.name: static fromValue
methods.description: Creates a Long from a LongLike value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns the sum of this Long and another LongLike.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Bitwise AND operation.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compare this Long to another LongLike.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Division operation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Check equality with another LongLike.

methods.name: getHighBits
methods.description: Get the high 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getHighBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Get the high 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: getLowBits
methods.description: Get the low 32 bits as a signed integer.

methods.name: getLowBitsUnsigned
methods.description: Get the low 32 bits as an unsigned integer.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Check if this Long is greater than another.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Check if this Long is less than another.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Check if this Long's value is zero.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiply this Long by another LongLike.

methods.name: negate
methods.description: Negate this Long's value.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Bitwise NOT operation.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Bitwise OR operation.

methods.name: shiftLeft
methods.description: Shift bits to the left.

methods.name: shiftRight
methods.description: Arithmetic right shift.

methods.name: shiftRightUnsigned
methods.description: Logical right shift.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Subtract another LongLike from this Long.

methods.name: toBigInt
methods.description: Convert to BigInt.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Convert to 32-bit integer.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Convert to a JavaScript number.

methods.name: toBytes
methods.description: Get byte array representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Convert to string with optional radix.

methods.name: unsigned
methods.description: Convert this Long to unsigned Long.

methods.name: toSigned
methods.description: Convert to signed Long.
